title: introduce-multi-sdk-auth-bridge-ergonomic-connector-and-traceable-retry-bump
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Adds a lightweight multi-sdk credential bridge with tracing metadata and retry-presets. Bumps TS/Go/Python SDKs minor versions. No public API breaking changes.
description: Context: Multiple SDKs had divergent credential helpers and retry defaults, causing inconsistent streaming reconnection behavior and absent cross-sdk tracing for auth events. Motivation: provide a single lightweight bridge in the redwood control plane that standardizes (1) credential fetch/fallback semantics, (2) streaming reconnect presets, and (3) attach explicit tracing/telemetry markers for auth lifecycle events across Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs. This PR implements: - a small 'credential-orchestra' shim that lives in each SDK and delegates to a shared policy surface (pluggable) - explicit RetryProfile presets exposed as ergonomics-friendly factories (latency-first, cost-first, steady-load) - stream handshake telemetry points (auth.requested, auth.succeeded, auth.refresh, auth.failed) to aid SRE/Debugging - minor API ergonomics: simplified session factory signatures and single-arg stream helpers - version bumps: python-sdk v3.8.1, typescript-sdk v1.28.3, go-sdk v1.6.2 Checklist: [x] implement credential-orchestra adapter in TS/Py/Go [x] add RetryProfile factories and tests [x] add telemetry spans and event markers [x] docs + examples updated [x] QA run and canary on dedicated infra [x] release notes drafted Scope of changes: Commits: - feat(credential): add credential-orchestra adapter and fallback chain (d2f4a6c) - feat(retry): introduce RetryProfile factories and presets (b9c1f2d) - perf(stream): wire auth lifecycle telemetry into stream handshake (3e11b77) - chore(sdk): bump versions across py/ts/go and update changelogs (e5a2b88) - test: add cross-sdk integration tests for reconnect and auth-fallthrough (7f4d3e1) Changed areas (high level): - sdks/typescript/src/credential-orchestra.ts (+ adapter tests) - sdks/typescript/src/stream/handshake.ts (+ telemetry markers) - sdks/typescript/package.json - sdks/python/redwood/credential_orchestra.py (+ session_factory) - sdks/python/redwood/streaming/handshake.py (+trace integration) - sdks/python/setup.cfg - sdks/go/credentials/orchestra.go (+retry presets) - sdks/go/stream/handshake.go - docs/sdk/auth.md (new section) - examples/multi-sdk/credential-fallback/ (new samples) - tests/integration/mock_auth_server.go - ci/fixtures/go_auth_fixture.sh Test strategy: unit tests per SDK (credential fallback, preset selection), integration tests that run a mock auth server and exercise refresh and failover, and an end-to-end canary against Dedicated staging. Observability: new metrics auth.event.count{kind=..}, auth.latency_ms, and span attributes redwood.cred.mode and redwood.retry.preset. CI: initial CI run failed on the Go integration job due to missing test fixture; the fixture was added in commit 7f4d3e1 and CI rerun passed. Review summary: Reviewers requested API clarity, telemetry naming, and docs. See review_comments for details. Backwards compatibility: adapter is additive. Existing SDK auth helpers are preserved; customers can opt-in to the new default via minor SDK upgrade. Rollout plan: - cut SDK minors, publish packages - enable bridge by default in Hosted infra canary cohort - monitor auth.event.* and retry metrics for regressions - rollback by toggling opt-in flag in console if regressions observed.

Zoe Chen: Would like the telemetry attributes names to follow 'redwood.auth.*' instead of 'auth.*' for consistency with other spans.

merge_commit_message:
squash: introduce multi-sdk credential orchestra, retry presets, and auth telemetry

Adds a lightweight cross-sdk adapter to standardize auth/fallback behavior, retry presets, and traceable auth events. Bumps SDK versions and updates docs/examples.
